title: Nothing Teases Screen-Free AI Device for December Launch
excerpt: Nothing CEO Carl Pei has announced plans to launch the company's first AI device in December, teasing a screen-free design.
body_html:
Nothing is preparing to launch its first artificial intelligence device in December, according to an announcement by company CEO Carl Pei on X. The upcoming release follows plans previously announced by Pei for an AI operating system and AI-native hardware.

While specific details about the upcoming product remain scarce, Pei indicated that the device will feature a screen-free design. Further information regarding the hardware and its capabilities is expected ahead of the official launch next month.
